3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: operations O1–O16
5	
6	The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75. Each
7	operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
8	an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
9	relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
10	`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
14	
15	/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
16	effects of §72 and §73). -/
17	def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
18	  | _, [] => []
19	  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l
20	
21	/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/
22	
23	/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
24	identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
25	def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
26	  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩
27	
28	/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
29	structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
30	  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
31	  active : s.Active src
32	  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
33	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
34	  /-- §60.1: every authority of the origin chain of `source`, its effective anchor included, is
35	  active. -/
36	  chainActive : ∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x
37	  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
38	  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
39	  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
40	  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
41	  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
42	  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
43	  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
44	  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
45	  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
46	    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
47	    True
48	  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
49	  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F
50	
51	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
52	instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
53	    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
54	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ (∀ x ∈ s.ancs src, s.Active x) ∧
55	    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
56	    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
57	    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
58	      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
59	      True) ∧
60	    s.top ∈ s.F)
61	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
62	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
63	
64	/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
65	def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
66	  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)
67	
68	/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/
69	
70	/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
71	per region, held by the current frame. -/
72	def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
73	  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }
74	
75	/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
76	descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
77	def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
78	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
79	    False
80	
81	/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
82	instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
83	  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance
84	
85	/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
86	structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
87	  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
88	  active : s.Active src
89	  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
90	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
91	  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
92	  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
93	  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
94	  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
95	  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
96	  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
97	  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
98	  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p
99	
100	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
101	instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
102	    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
103	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
104	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
105	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
106	    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
107	    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
108	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
109	
110	/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
111	def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
112	  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)
113	
114	/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/
115	
116	/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
117	the anchors of its holding place. -/
118	def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
119	  | some x => { s with
120	      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
121	      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
122	  | none => s
123	
124	/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
125	the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
126	def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
127	  | .frame f => f = s.top
128	  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p
129	
130	/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
131	instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
132	  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance
133	
134	/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
135	structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
136	  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
137	  active : s.Active a
138	  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
139	  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
140	  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
141	  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
142	  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
143	  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
144	  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
145	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
146	    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)
147	
148	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
149	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
150	  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
151	    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
152	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
153	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
154	      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
155	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
156	
157	/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
158	def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
159	  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)
160	
161	/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/
162	
163	/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
164	def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
165	  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)
166	
167	/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
168	def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
169	  | [] => 0
170	  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1
171	
172	/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
173	position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
174	def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
175	  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
176	  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
177	      match parentOf P r with
178	      | some p => if p < r then
179	          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
180	      | none => none
181	
182	/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
183	def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r
184	
185	/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
186	with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
187	def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
188	  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
189	    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
190	  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
191	    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z
192	
193	/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
194	instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
195	  unfold SameShape; infer_instance
196	
197	/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
198	def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
199	  | .place r => partOf P r q
200	  | .frame _ => False
201	
202	/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
203	instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
204	  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance
205	
206	/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
207	`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
208	def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
209	  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
210	  | .frame f => .frame f
211	
212	/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
213	part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
214	def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
215	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
216	    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D
217	
218	/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
219	destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
220	to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
221	def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
222	  { s with
223	    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
224	      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
225	    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
226	      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
227	    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
228	    A := s.A.map fun y =>
229	      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }
230	
231	/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
232	def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
233	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
234	    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False
235	
236	/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
237	instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
238	  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance
239	
240	/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
241	transitively. -/
242	def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
243	  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
244	  | .frame _ => False
245	
246	/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
247	instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
248	  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance
249	
250	/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
251	def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
252	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False
253	
254	/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
255	instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
256	  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance
257	
258	/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
259	parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
260	def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
261	  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
262	    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D
263	
264	/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
265	def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
266	  | .place p => footprint s.P p
267	  | .frame _ => []
268	
269	/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
270	def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
271	  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False
272	
273	/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
274	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance
275	
276	/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
277	in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
278	def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
279	  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
280	    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j
281	
282	/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
283	instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
284	  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance
285	
286	/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
287	structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
288	  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
289	  srcUsable : s.Usable src
290	  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
291	  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
292	  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
293	  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
294	  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
295	  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
296	  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
297	  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
298	  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
299	  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
300	  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
301	  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
302	  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
303	  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
304	  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
305	  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
306	  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
307	  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
308	    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
309	  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
310	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
311	  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
312	  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
313	  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
314	  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
315	  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
316	  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
317	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
318	      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
319	        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
320	  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
321	  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
322	  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
323	  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst
324	
325	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
326	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
327	    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
328	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
329	    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
330	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
331	    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
332	      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
333	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
334	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
335	    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
336	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
337	        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
338	          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
339	    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
340	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
341	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
342	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
343	      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩
344	
345	/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
346	def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
347	  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)
348	
349	/-! ## O5 `depend` (§64) -/
350	
351	/-- Effect of `depend(result, anchor)` (§64, `ok` effect): `anchor` is added to `D(result)`. -/
352	def dependEff (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : S3 :=
353	  { s with D := fun r => if r = q then s.D q ++ [x] else s.D r }
354	
355	/-- Preconditions of `depend` (§64). The "real dependency" part of §64.2 is not represented;
356	§64.4 holds by construction (`depsOf`). -/
357	structure DependPre (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Prop where
358	  /-- §64.1: `result` is usable. -/
359	  usable : s.Usable q
360	  /-- §64.1: exercisable `Modify` over `result`. -/
361	  right : HasRight s .modify q
362	  /-- §64.2: `anchor` is active. -/
363	  anchorActive : s.Active x
364	  /-- §64.3: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an ancestor. -/
365	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)
366	
367	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `depend` (§64). -/
368	instance (s : S3) (q x : Nat) : Decidable (DependPre s q x) :=
369	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable q ∧ HasRight s .modify q ∧ s.Active x ∧ EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q))
370	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
371	
372	/-- `depend` as a relation (§64). -/
373	def DependStep (q x : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
374	  Guarded (DependPre s q x) (dependEff s q x)
375	
376	/-! ## O8 `store` (§65) -/
377	
378	/-- Effect of `store(authority, target)` (§65, `ok` effect): `target` becomes the holder, the
379	authority joins `D(target)`, and only leaf `target` becomes `Init`. -/
380	def storeEff (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
381	  | some y => { s with
382	      A := s.A.set a { y with holder := .place p }
383	      D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
384	      I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l }
385	  | none => s
386	
387	/-- Preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
388	structure StorePre (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Prop where
389	  /-- §65.1: the authority is active, derived, and held by the current frame. -/
390	  derivedHeld : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
391	    y.holder = .frame s.top) False
392	  /-- §65.2: `target` is usable. -/
393	  usable : s.Usable p
394	  /-- §65.2: `target` is a leaf. -/
395	  leaf : isLeaf s.P p
396	  /-- §65.2: exercisable `Modify` over `target`. -/
397	  right : HasRight s .modify p
398	  /-- §65.2: `target` holds no active authority. -/
399	  free : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
400	    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True
401	  /-- §65.3: the authority covers no leaf of `target` nor of storage it owns, transitively. -/
402	  noCover : ∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
403	    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q
404	  /-- §65.4: the effective anchor respects `AnchorOrder` relative to the frame of `target`. -/
405	  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p)
406	  /-- §65.5: in the resulting state, `target` is under exercisable `Modify`. -/
407	  keepsTarget : HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p
408	  /-- §65.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
409	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p)
410	
411	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `store` (§65). -/
412	instance (s : S3) (a p : Nat) : Decidable (StorePre s a p) :=
413	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧
414	      y.holder = .frame s.top) False ∧ s.Usable p ∧ isLeaf s.P p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
415	    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
416	      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place p) True) ∧
417	    (∀ l ∈ s.afp a, l ∉ footprint s.P p ∧
418	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, OwnedIn s.P p q → l ∉ footprint s.P q) ∧
419	    EffAnchorOK s a (s.pframe p) ∧ HasRight (storeEff s a p) .modify p ∧
420	    AnchorOrderHeld (storeEff s a p))
421	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩,
422	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i⟩⟩
423	
424	/-- `store` as a relation (§65). -/
425	def StoreStep (a p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
426	  Guarded (StorePre s a p) (storeEff s a p)
427	
428	/-! ## Shapes (§47, §71.1, §72) -/
429	
430	/-- A local shape as a shape whose elements have no owning element (§71.1, §72: locals and
431	allocated storage are owned by the receiving holder). -/
432	def LocalShape.toShape (ls : LocalShape) : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) :=
433	  ls.map fun e => (e.1, none, e.2)
434	
435	/-- Owner of element `i` of a shape (§47, §72, §71): its owning element if any, `hd`
436	otherwise. -/
437	def shapeOwner (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) : Holder :=
438	  match (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
439	  | some o => .place o
440	  | none => hd
441	
442	/-- Places `P` followed by the elements of a shape (§47, §71, §72): (parent, owning element,
443	kind), owned by their owning element or by `hd`. -/
444	def shapeP (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) :
445	    List Place :=
446	  P ++ (List.range ls.length).map fun i =>
447	    ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩
448	
449	/-- Well-formed shape at offset `n` (§72.2, §71.1; for statics, the hypothesis recorded for
450	§47): the parent and the owning element of an element are earlier elements, and a part has the
451	owning element of its parent. -/
452	def ShapeOK (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Prop :=
453	  ∀ i ∈ List.range ls.length,
454	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)) (fun r => n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i ∧
455	      (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = (ls[r - n]?).bind (·.2.1)) True ∧
456	    OptP ((ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1)) (fun o => n ≤ o ∧ o < n + i) True
457	
458	/-- Decidability of `ShapeOK` (§72.2, §71.1). -/
459	instance (n : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : Decidable (ShapeOK n ls) := by
460	  unfold ShapeOK; infer_instance
461	
462	/-- Indices of the root elements (no parent) of a shape (§40 root places; §47, §71, §72). -/
463	def rootIdx (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) : List Nat :=
464	  (List.range ls.length).filter fun i => ((ls[i]?).bind (·.1)).isNone
465	
466	/-! ## O6 `enterFrame` (§72) -/
467	
468	/-- Places after `enterFrame` (§72, `ok` effect): the locals appended, owned by the new frame. -/
469	def enterP (s : S3) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place := shapeP s.P (.frame s.nF) ls.toShape
470	
471	/-- Effect of `enterFrame(params, locals)` (§72, `ok` effect): a new frame `nF` is pushed; the
472	parameters are now held by it; locals are appended (uninitialized, no anchor, alive) with one
473	active root `Modify` authority per root local, held by the new frame; pinning obligations are
474	unchanged. -/
475	def enterEff (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
476	  { F := s.nF :: s.F, nF := s.nF + 1, P := enterP s ls
477	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
478	    A := mapI (fun j y => if j ∈ ps then { y with holder := .frame s.nF } else y) 0 s.A ++
479	      (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
480	        ⟨.modify, none, footprint (enterP s ls) (s.P.length + i),
481	          shapeOwner ls.toShape (.frame s.nF) i, true⟩
482	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
483	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
484	    pins := s.pins }
485	
486	/-- Origin protection on entry for parameter `p` in state `s'` (§72.3): if `p` is a `Modify`
487	authority with direct origin `o`, `o` is exercisable in no mode. -/
488	def ParamOriginHidden (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
489	  OptP (s'.A[p]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify →
490	    OptP y.origin (fun o => ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .observe ∧ ¬ s'.ExercisableAt o .modify) True) True
491	
492	/-- Decidability of `ParamOriginHidden` (§72.3). -/
493	instance (s' : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (ParamOriginHidden s' p) := by
494	  unfold ParamOriginHidden; infer_instance
495	
496	/-- Preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). The modes/footprints/parameter-passing part of §72.2 is
497	not represented. -/
498	structure EnterPre (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
499	  /-- §72.1: the calling frame, the current frame, is live. -/
500	  callerLive : s.F ≠ []
501	  /-- §72.1: each parameter is an active derived authority held by the caller. -/
502	  params : ∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.holder = .frame s.top ∧
503	    y.origin ≠ none) False
504	  /-- §72.2: the locals form a well-formed shape (each parent is an earlier local). -/
505	  localsOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
506	  /-- §72.3: origin protection on entry, in the resulting state. -/
507	  originHidden : ∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p
508	  /-- §72.4: `AnchorOrderHeld` over the resulting state. -/
509	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls)
510	
511	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `enterFrame` (§72). -/
512	instance (s : S3) (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (EnterPre s ps ls) :=
513	  decidable_of_iff (s.F ≠ [] ∧ (∀ a ∈ ps, OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧
514	      y.holder = .frame s.top ∧ y.origin ≠ none) False) ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧
515	    (∀ p ∈ ps, ParamOriginHidden (enterEff s ps ls) p) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (enterEff s ps ls))
516	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
517	
518	/-- `enterFrame` as a relation (§72). -/
519	def EnterStep (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
520	  Guarded (EnterPre s ps ls) (enterEff s ps ls)
521	
522	/-! ## O7 `exitFrame` (§73) -/
523	
524	/-- Authority `x` survives the exit to stack `F₀` (§73.4): active and held by a surviving frame
525	or by a usable place whose terminal owner survives. -/
526	def Survives (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Prop :=
527	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ HolderLive { s with F := F₀ } y.holder) False
528	
529	/-- Decidability of `Survives` (§73.4). -/
530	instance (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (x : Nat) : Decidable (Survives s F₀ x) := by
531	  unfold Survives; infer_instance
532	
533	/-- First surviving authority of a list (§73.4). -/
534	def firstSurv (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (l : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
535	  l.find? fun z => decide (Survives s F₀ z)
536	
537	/-- Authority `a` after the exit (§73, `ok` effect): released unless it survives; a surviving
538	derived authority is reanchored to the first surviving active origin of its chain. -/
539	def exitG (s : S3) (F₀ : Frames) (a : Nat) (y : Authority) : Authority :=
540	  if Survives s F₀ a then
541	    match y.origin with
542	    | none => y
543	    | some _ => { y with origin := firstSurv s F₀ (s.ancs a) }
544	  else { y with active := false }
545	
546	/-- Effect of `exitFrame` (§73, `ok` effect): the current frame is popped; authorities that do
547	not survive are released; surviving derived authorities and the anchors of `D` are reanchored to
548	the first surviving authority of their chains. -/
549	def exitEff (s : S3) : S3 :=
550	  { s with
551	    F := s.F.tail
552	    D := fun q => (s.D q).map fun x => (firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x)).getD x
553	    A := mapI (exitG s s.F.tail) 0 s.A }
554	
555	/-- Preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). The result clause of §73.2 is not represented. -/
556	structure ExitPre (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop where
557	  /-- §73.1: the current frame is not the initial frame and has a surviving caller. -/
558	  hasCaller : s.F.tail ≠ []
559	  /-- §73.2, §73.4, §73.5: every anchor of a place usable after the exit has a surviving
560	  authority among itself and its origins. -/
561	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
562	    ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none
563	  /-- §73.4: every surviving derived authority has a surviving active origin. -/
564	  origins : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
565	    firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none
566	  /-- §73.3: no leaf of a place that dies with the frame is pinned, statically or
567	  dynamically. -/
568	  notPinned : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q →
569	    ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
570	    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
571	  /-- §73.5: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
572	  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s)
573	
574	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `exitFrame` (§73). -/
575	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) : Decidable (ExitPre k s) :=
576	  decidable_of_iff (s.F.tail ≠ [] ∧
577	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
578	      ∀ x ∈ s.D q, firstSurv s s.F.tail (x :: s.ancs x) ≠ none) ∧
579	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, Survives s s.F.tail a → s.org a ≠ none →
580	      firstSurv s s.F.tail (s.ancs a) ≠ none) ∧
581	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ¬ ({ s with F := s.F.tail } : S3).Usable q →
582	      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l) ∧
583	    AnchorOrderHeld (exitEff s))
584	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
585	
586	/-- `exitFrame` as a relation (§73). -/
587	def ExitStep (k : K) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (ExitPre k s) (exitEff s)
588	
589	/-! ## O9 `read`, O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` (§66–§68) -/
590	
591	/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
592	def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
593	  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q
594	
595	/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
596	instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
597	  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance
598	
599	/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
600	contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
601	structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
602	  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
603	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
604	  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
605	  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
606	  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
607	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
608	  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
609	  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
610	  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
611	  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
612	
613	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
614	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
615	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
616	    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
617	    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
618	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
619	
620	/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
621	def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
622	  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s
623	
624	/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
625	storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
626	structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
627	  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
628	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
629	  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
630	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
631	  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
632	  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
633	  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
634	  over the written leaves. -/
635	  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
636	  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
637	  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
638	
639	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
640	instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
641	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
642	    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
643	    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
644	    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
645	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
646	
647	/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
648	def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
649	  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }
650	
651	/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
652	def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
653	  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)
654	
655	/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
656	structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
657	  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
658	  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
659	  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
660	  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
661	  /-- §68.2: `access` is exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`. -/
662	  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
663	  /-- §68.2: `access` has a present effective mode on every leaf. -/
664	  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
665	  /-- §68.3: dependencies are valid. -/
666	  depsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l
667	
668	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `writeShared` (§68). -/
669	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
670	    Decidable (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) :=
671	  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l) ∧
672	    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
673	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩
674	
675	/-- `writeShared` as a relation (§68). -/
676	def WriteSharedStep (k : K) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
677	  Guarded (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)
678	
679	/-! ## Release of authorities whose holder dies (§69, §70) -/
680	
681	/-- Releases every authority whose holder is no longer live (§69, §70 `ok` effects). -/
682	def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
683	  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }
684	
685	/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/
686	
687	/-- `endUse p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§69, `ok` effect): the leaves of
688	`p` become `Uninit`; authorities held within `p` are released; anchors of `p` and its parts are
689	removed; storage owned by `p`, transitively, is marked dead. -/
690	def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
691	  { s with
692	    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
693	    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
694	    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (OwnedIn s.P p q)
695	    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }
696	
697	/-- Effect of `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died
698	are released. -/
699	def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)
700	
701	/-- Leaf whose use ends with the value at `p` (§69.2, §69.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that
702	stops being usable. -/
703	def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
704	  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)
705	
706	/-- Decidability of `EndingLeaf` (§69). -/
707	instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
708	  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance
709	
710	/-- Root authority of the value at `p` (§69.3): an authority with no origin covering a leaf of
711	`p`. -/
712	def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
713	  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint
714	
715	/-- Decidability of `IsRootOf` (§69.3). -/
716	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
717	  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance
718	
719	/-- Authority `j` does not block `endUse p` (§69.2): if it is an active derived authority over an
720	ending leaf, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
721	def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
722	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
723	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) →
724	      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True
725	
726	/-- Decidability of `EndUseAccessOK` (§69.2). -/
727	instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
728	  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
729	
730	/-- Anchor `x` survives `endUse p` (§69.3): not held within `p`, not a root of `p`, with a holder
731	that stays live. -/
732	def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
733	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
734	    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True
735	
736	/-- Decidability of `EndUseAnchorOK` (§69.3). -/
737	instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
738	  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
739	
740	/-- Preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
741	structure EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
742	  /-- §69.1: `place` is usable. -/
743	  usable : s.Usable p
744	  /-- §69.1: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
745	  right : HasRight s .modify p
746	  /-- §69.2: no active derived authority over an ending leaf is held outside the dying places,
747	  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
748	  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
749	  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
750	    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j
751	  /-- §69.2, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
752	  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
753	  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
754	    ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j
755	  /-- §69.3: no place usable after the effect depends on an authority held by `place`, its root,
756	  or an authority whose holder dies. -/
757	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
758	    ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x
759	  /-- §69.4: no ending leaf, owned storage included, is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
760	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
761	
762	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `endUse` (§69). -/
763	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) :=
764	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
765	    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
766	      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
767	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
768	      ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active j) ∧
769	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q →
770	      ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q, EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
771	    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
772	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩
773	
774	/-- `endUse` as a relation (§69). -/
775	def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
776	  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)
777	
778	/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/
779	
780	/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
781	def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
782	  | .place _ => true
783	  | .frame _ => false
784	
785	/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
786	def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
787	  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False
788	
789	/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
790	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
791	  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance
792	
793	/-- Place `q` belongs to the unit released by `free p` (§70): a part of `p`, or storage owned by
794	`p`, transitively. -/
795	def FreedPlace (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := partOf P q p ∨ OwnedIn P p q
796	
797	/-- Decidability of `FreedPlace` (§70). -/

798	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (FreedPlace P p q) := by
799	  unfold FreedPlace; infer_instance

801	/-- `free p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§70, `ok` effect): the released unit
802	is marked dead; authorities covering it, roots included, or held within `p` become inactive. -/
803	def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
804	  { s with
805	    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (FreedPlace s.P p q)
806	    A := s.A.map fun y =>
807	      if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
808	        { y with active := false } else y }
809	
810	/-- Effect of `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
811	released. -/
812	def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)
813	
814	/-- Leaf of the released unit (§70.3, §70.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that stops being
815	usable. -/
816	def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
817	  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)
818	
819	/-- Decidability of `FreedLeaf` (§70). -/
820	instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
821	  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance
822	
823	/-- Authority `j` does not block `free p` (§70.3): if it is an active derivative over the
824	footprint being freed, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
825	def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
826	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
827	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) →
828	      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True
829	
830	/-- Decidability of `FreeAccessOK` (§70.3). -/
831	instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAccessOK s p j) := by
832	  unfold FreeAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
833	
834	/-- Anchor `x` survives `free p` (§70.3): it covers no leaf of the released unit, is not held
835	within `p`, and its holder stays live. -/
836	def FreeAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
837	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧
838	    HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True
839	
840	/-- Decidability of `FreeAnchorOK` (§70.3). -/
841	instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (FreeAnchorOK s p x) := by
842	  unfold FreeAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance
843	
844	/-- Preconditions of `free p auth` (§70). -/
845	structure FreePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) : Prop where
846	  /-- §70.1: `place` is an `OwnedRoot`. -/
847	  ownedRoot : OwnedRoot s p
848	  /-- §70.2: `K.Deallocable(place)`. -/
849	  deallocable : k.Deallocable p
850	  /-- §70.2: `K.FreeCompat(place, auth)`. -/
851	  freeCompat : k.FreeCompat p auth
852	  /-- §70.3: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
853	  right : HasRight s .modify p
854	  /-- §70.3: no active derivative over the footprint being freed is held outside dying holders,
855	  except the authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over `place`: some
856	  authority grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
857	  access : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
858	    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j
859	  /-- §70.3, last sentence: no authority that the effect makes inactive has an active descendant
860	  that the effect does not make inactive. -/
861	  keptDesc : ∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
862	    ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j
863	  /-- §70.3: no surviving place is anchored to an authority of the released unit or of its dead
864	  holders. -/
865	  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x
866	  /-- §70.4: no leaf of the released unit is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
867	  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l
868	
869	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `free` (§70). -/
870	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
871	    [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] (s : S3) (p auth : Nat) :
872	    Decidable (FreePre k s p auth) :=
873	  decidable_of_iff (OwnedRoot s p ∧ k.Deallocable p ∧ k.FreeCompat p auth ∧
874	    HasRight s .modify p ∧
875	    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify p g ∧
876	      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, RightChain s g j ∨ FreeAccessOK s p j) ∧
877	    (∀ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.Active a →
878	      ¬ (freeEff s p).Active a → a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ (freeEff s p).Active j) ∧
879	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧
880	    (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, FreedLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l))
881	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
882	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
883	
884	/-- `free` as a relation (§70). -/
885	def FreeStep (k : K) (p auth : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
886	  Guarded (FreePre k s p auth) (freeEff s p)

888	/-! ## O14 `alloc` (§71) -/
889	
890	/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
891	structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
892	  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
893	  nonempty : ls ≠ []
894	  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
895	  element). -/
896	  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
897	  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
898	  parent. -/
899	  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
900	  /-- §71.2: the provider is a usable place. -/
901	  providerUsable : s.Usable provider
902	  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
903	  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
904	  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
905	  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
906	  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
907	    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
908	  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
909	  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
910	  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
911	  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner
912	
913	/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
914	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
915	    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
916	  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
917	    s.Usable provider ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
918	    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
919	      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
920	    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
921	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
922	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩
923	
924	/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
925	`owner`. -/
926	def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
927	  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape
928	
929	/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
930	`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, with a root `Modify` authority with no origin held
931	by `owner`; pinning obligations are unchanged. -/
932	def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
933	  { s with
934	    P := allocP s owner ls
935	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
936	    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
937	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
938	        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
939	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
940	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q }
941	
942	/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
943	precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
944	inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
945	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
946	  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
947	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
948	  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
949	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
950	  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject
951	
952	/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/
953	
954	/-- Preconditions of `pin` (§74). "Applicable pinning obligations" is not represented. -/
955	structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
956	  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
957	  usable : s.Usable p
958	  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
959	  right : HasRight s .modify p
960	
961	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `pin` (§74). -/
962	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (PinPre s p) :=
963	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
964	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
965	
966	/-- Effect of `pin` (§74, `ok` effect): an active dynamic pinning obligation of fresh identity
967	`|pins|` is installed on the leaves of `place`. -/
968	def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
969	  { s with pins := s.pins ++ [⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩] }
970	
971	/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
972	def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p)
973	
974	/-- Effect of `unpin` (§75, `ok` effect): the designated obligation `o` ends, and only that
975	one. -/
976	def unpinEff (s : S3) (o : Nat) : S3 :=
977	  { s with pins := s.pins.modify o fun ob => { ob with active := false } }
978	
979	/-- Preconditions of `unpin o` (§75), `o` the identity of a dynamic pinning obligation. -/
980	structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (o : Nat) : Prop where
981	  /-- §75: `unpin` designates an active dynamic pinning obligation. -/
982	  active : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False
983	  /-- §75: `place`, on which the obligation was installed by `pin`, is usable. -/
984	  usable : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False
985	  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
986	  right : OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False
987	  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone`, applied to the obligation. -/
988	  externalDone : k.ExternalDone o
989	
990	/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
991	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (o : Nat) :
992	    Decidable (UnpinPre k s o) :=
993	  decidable_of_iff (OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => ob.active = true) False ∧
994	    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => s.Usable ob.place) False ∧
995	    OptP (s.pins[o]?) (fun ob => HasRight s .modify ob.place) False ∧ k.ExternalDone o)
996	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩
997	
998	/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
999	def UnpinStep (k : K) (o : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
1000	  Guarded (UnpinPre k s o) (unpinEff s o)
1001	
1002	/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/
1003	
1004	/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
1005	inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
1006	  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
1007	      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1008	  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
1009	      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1010	  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1011	  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1012	  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1013	  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
1014	      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1015	  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1016	  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1017	  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1018	  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
1019	      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1020	  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1021	  | unpin {s s' : S3} {o : Nat} : UnpinStep k o s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1022	  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1023	  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1024	  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
1025	      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1026	  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
1027	
1028	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
7	`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
8	(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
9	O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
10	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
14	
15	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
16	
17	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
18	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
19	
20	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
21	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
22	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
23	
24	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
25	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
26	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
27	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
28	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
29	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
30	
31	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
32	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
33	place. -/
34	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
35	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
36	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
37	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
38	
39	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
40	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
41	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
42	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
43	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
44	
45	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
46	
47	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
48	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
49	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
50	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
51	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
52	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
53	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
54	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
55	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
56	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
57	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
58	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
59	      f < s.nF) ∧
60	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
61	      o < s.P.length) ∧
62	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
63	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
64	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
65	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
66	  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
67	  root authority. -/
68	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
69	  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
70	  rootChain : RootChain s
71	  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
72	  rootHeld : RootHeld s
73	  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
74	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
75	    HolderLive s y.holder
76	
77	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
78	
79	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
80	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
81	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
82	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
83	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
84	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
85	
86	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
87	origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
88	authority is valid, that is, active. -/
89	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
90	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
91	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
92	      (y.active = true → x.active = true)
93	
94	/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
95	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
96	
97	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
98	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
99	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls
100	
101	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
102	def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
103	
104	/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
105	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
106	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
107	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
108	
109	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
110	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
111	
112	/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
113	obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
114	(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
115	obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
116	def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
117	  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
118	    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q
119	
120	/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/
121	
122	/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
123	place holding `b`. -/
124	def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
125	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
126	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
127	    | .frame _ => False) False
128	
129	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
130	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
131	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
132	  | _ => True
133	
134	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
135	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
136	whole place holding the next. -/
137	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
138	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
139	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
140	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
141	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)
142	
143	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
144	
145	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
146	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
147	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
148	
149	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
150	paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
151	parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
152	static (§49.2). -/
153	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
154	
155	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
156	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
157	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
158	
159	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
160	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
161	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
162	dynamic pinning obligation. -/
163	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
164	  { F := [0]
165	    nF := 1
166	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
167	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
168	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
169	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
170	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
171	    D := fun _ => []
172	    dead := fun _ => false
173	    pins := [] }
174	
175	/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
176	directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
177	def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
178	  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
179	    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False
180	
181	/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/
182	
183	/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
184	inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
185	  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
186	  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'
187	
188	/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)
189	
190	Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
191	`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/
192	
193	namespace Examples
194	
195	/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
196	external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
197	def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
198	  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩
199	
200	/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
201	instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
202	  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
203	/-- Decidability of `K0.SharedMutable` (§48). -/
204	instance : DecidablePred K0.SharedMutable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
205	/-- Decidability of `K0.Pinned` (§48). -/
206	instance : DecidablePred K0.Pinned := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
207	/-- Decidability of `K0.ExternalDone` (§48). -/
208	instance : DecidablePred K0.ExternalDone := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
209	/-- Decidability of `K0.Deallocable` (§48). -/
210	instance : DecidablePred K0.Deallocable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
211	/-- Decidability of `K0.FreeCompat` (§48). -/
212	instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (K0.FreeCompat p a) := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
213	
214	/-- Three static leaves owned by frame 0 (§47): place 0 `Init`, places 1 and 2 `Uninit`. -/
215	def st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
216	
217	/-- `S3.init st` (§47). -/
218	def s0 : S3 := S3.init st
219	/-- After `derive(0, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 3 held by frame 0. -/
220	def s1 : S3 := deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify
221	/-- After `alloc(provider 0, owner 1, one leaf)` (§71): place 3 owned by place 1, root 3. -/
222	def s2 : S3 := allocEff s0 1 [(none, 0)]
223	/-- After `derive(1, [1], Modify)` then `store(3, 0)` (§60, §65): authority 3 on leaf 1 stored in
224	place 0. -/
225	def s3 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff s0 1 [1] .modify) 3 0
226	/-- After `pin(0)` (§74): obligation 0 pins leaf 0. -/
227	def s4 : S3 := pinEff s0 0
228	
229	example : StaticsOK st := by decide
230	example : DerivePre s0 0 [0] .modify := by decide
231	example : SplitPre K0 s0 0 [[0]] := by decide
232	example : ReleasePre s1 3 := by decide
233	example : TransferPre K0 s0 0 1 := by decide
234	example : ¬ TransferPre K0 s0 1 0 := by decide
235	example : DependPre s1 2 3 := by decide
236	example : EnterPre s1 [3] [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
237	example : StorePre s1 3 1 := by decide
238	example : ¬ ExitPre K0 s0 := by decide
239	example : Read3Pre s0 0 [0] := by decide
240	example : Write3Pre s0 1 [1] := by decide
241	example : WriteSharedPre K0 s0 0 [0] := by decide
242	example : EndUsePre K0 s0 0 := by decide
243	example : FreePre K0 s2 3 0 := by decide
244	example : AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
245	example : ¬ AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (none, 0)] := by decide
246	example : PinPre s0 0 := by decide
247	example : UnpinPre K0 s4 0 := by decide
248	example : ¬ UnpinPre K0 s0 0 := by decide
249	example : ¬ EndUsePre K0 s4 0 := by decide
250	
251	/-- §75: `unpin` ends only the designated obligation; with two obligations on leaf 0, ending
252	obligation 0 leaves the leaf pinned by obligation 1. -/
253	example : (unpinEff (pinEff s4 0) 0).pin 0 = true ∧ (unpinEff s4 0).pin 0 = false := by decide
254	
255	/-- §63.8 decides alone: in `s3`, the transfer of place 0 to place 1 satisfies §63.1–§63.7 and
256	§63.9 and is rejected by local self-blocking prevention. -/
257	example : (s3.Usable 0 ∧ s3.Usable 1 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 1 ∧
258	    SameShape s3.P 0 1 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, s3.I l = .init) ∧
259	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 1, s3.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s3.P 0 1 ∧
260	    (∃ g ∈ List.range s3.A.length, Grounds s3 .modify 0 g ∧
261	      ∀ j ∈ List.range s3.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s3 0 j → RightChain s3 g j) ∧
262	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, ¬ K0.Pinned l ∧ s3.pin l = false) ∧
263	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s3 0, s3.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s3 0 1) ∧
264	    (∀ x ∈ List.range s3.A.length, AnchorMoves s3 0 x →
265	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s3.P.length, (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable q →
266	        OptP ((transferEff s3 0 1).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
267	          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s3 0 1) x ((transferEff s3 0 1).pframe q)) True) ∧
268	    (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable 1) ∧
269	    ¬ NoLocalSelfLock s3 0 1 ∧ ¬ TransferPre K0 s3 0 1 := by decide
270	
271	end Examples
272	
273	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
274
