1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
7	`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
8	(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
9	O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
10	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
11	-/
12	
13	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
14	
15	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
16	
17	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
18	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
19	
20	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
21	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
22	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
23	
24	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
25	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
26	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
27	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
28	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
29	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
30	
31	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
32	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
33	place. -/
34	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
35	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
36	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
37	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
38	
39	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
40	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
41	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
42	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
43	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
44	
45	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
46	
47	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
48	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
49	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
50	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
51	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
52	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
53	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
54	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
55	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
56	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
57	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
58	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
59	      f < s.nF) ∧
60	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
61	      o < s.P.length) ∧
62	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
63	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
64	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
65	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
66	  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
67	  root authority. -/
68	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
69	  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
70	  rootChain : RootChain s
71	  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
72	  rootHeld : RootHeld s
73	  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
74	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
75	    HolderLive s y.holder
76	
77	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
78	
79	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
80	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
81	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
82	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
83	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
84	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
85	
86	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
87	origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
88	authority is valid, that is, active. -/
89	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
90	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
91	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
92	      (y.active = true → x.active = true)
93	
94	/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
95	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x
96	
97	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
98	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
99	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls
100	
101	/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
102	def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s
103	
104	/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
105	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
106	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
107	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
108	
109	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
110	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s
111	
112	/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
113	obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
114	(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
115	obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
116	def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
117	  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
118	    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q
119	
120	/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/
121	
122	/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
123	place holding `b`. -/
124	def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
125	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
126	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
127	    | .frame _ => False) False
128	
129	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
130	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
131	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
132	  | _ => True
133	
134	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
135	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
136	whole place holding the next. -/
137	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
138	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
139	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
140	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
141	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)
142	
143	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
144	
145	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
146	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
147	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
148	
149	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
150	paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
151	parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
152	static (§49.2). -/
153	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
154	
155	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
156	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
157	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
158	
159	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
160	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
161	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
162	dynamic pinning obligation. -/
163	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
164	  { F := [0]
165	    nF := 1
166	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
167	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
168	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
169	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
170	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
171	    D := fun _ => []
172	    dead := fun _ => false
173	    pins := [] }
174	
175	/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
176	directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
177	def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
178	  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
179	    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False
180	
181	/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/
182	
183	/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
184	inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
185	  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
186	  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'
187	
188	/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)
189	
190	Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
191	`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/
192	
193	namespace Examples
194	
195	/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
196	external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
197	def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
198	  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩
199	
200	/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
201	instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
202	  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
203	/-- Decidability of `K0.SharedMutable` (§48). -/
204	instance : DecidablePred K0.SharedMutable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
205	/-- Decidability of `K0.Pinned` (§48). -/
206	instance : DecidablePred K0.Pinned := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
207	/-- Decidability of `K0.ExternalDone` (§48). -/
208	instance : DecidablePred K0.ExternalDone := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
209	/-- Decidability of `K0.Deallocable` (§48). -/
210	instance : DecidablePred K0.Deallocable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
211	/-- Decidability of `K0.FreeCompat` (§48). -/
212	instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (K0.FreeCompat p a) := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
213	
214	/-- Three static leaves owned by frame 0 (§47): place 0 `Init`, places 1 and 2 `Uninit`. -/
215	def st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]
216	
217	/-- `S3.init st` (§47). -/
218	def s0 : S3 := S3.init st
219	/-- After `derive(0, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 3 held by frame 0. -/
220	def s1 : S3 := deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify
221	/-- After `alloc(provider 0, owner 1, one leaf)` (§71): place 3 owned by place 1, root 3. -/
222	def s2 : S3 := allocEff s0 1 [(none, 0)]
223	/-- After `derive(1, [1], Modify)` then `store(3, 0)` (§60, §65): authority 3 on leaf 1 stored in
224	place 0. -/
225	def s3 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff s0 1 [1] .modify) 3 0
226	/-- After `pin(0)` (§74): obligation 0 pins leaf 0. -/
227	def s4 : S3 := pinEff s0 0
228	
229	example : StaticsOK st := by decide
230	example : DerivePre s0 0 [0] .modify := by decide
231	example : SplitPre K0 s0 0 [[0]] := by decide
232	example : ReleasePre s1 3 := by decide
233	example : TransferPre K0 s0 0 1 := by decide
234	example : ¬ TransferPre K0 s0 1 0 := by decide
235	example : DependPre s1 2 3 := by decide
236	example : EnterPre s1 [3] [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
237	example : StorePre s1 3 1 := by decide
238	example : ¬ ExitPre K0 s0 := by decide
239	example : Read3Pre s0 0 [0] := by decide
240	example : Write3Pre s0 1 [1] := by decide
241	example : WriteSharedPre K0 s0 0 [0] := by decide
242	example : EndUsePre K0 s0 0 := by decide
243	example : FreePre K0 s2 3 0 := by decide
244	example : AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
245	example : ¬ AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (none, 0)] := by decide
246	example : PinPre s0 0 := by decide
247	example : UnpinPre K0 s4 0 := by decide
248	example : ¬ UnpinPre K0 s0 0 := by decide
249	example : ¬ EndUsePre K0 s4 0 := by decide
250	
251	/-- §75: `unpin` ends only the designated obligation; with two obligations on leaf 0, ending
252	obligation 0 leaves the leaf pinned by obligation 1. -/
253	example : (unpinEff (pinEff s4 0) 0).pin 0 = true ∧ (unpinEff s4 0).pin 0 = false := by decide
254	
255	/-- §63.8 decides alone: in `s3`, the transfer of place 0 to place 1 satisfies §63.1–§63.7 and
256	§63.9 and is rejected by local self-blocking prevention. -/
257	example : (s3.Usable 0 ∧ s3.Usable 1 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 1 ∧
258	    SameShape s3.P 0 1 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, s3.I l = .init) ∧
259	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 1, s3.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s3.P 0 1 ∧
260	    (∃ g ∈ List.range s3.A.length, Grounds s3 .modify 0 g ∧
261	      ∀ j ∈ List.range s3.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s3 0 j → RightChain s3 g j) ∧
262	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, ¬ K0.Pinned l ∧ s3.pin l = false) ∧
263	    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s3 0, s3.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s3 0 1) ∧
264	    (∀ x ∈ List.range s3.A.length, AnchorMoves s3 0 x →
265	      ∀ q ∈ List.range s3.P.length, (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable q →
266	        OptP ((transferEff s3 0 1).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
267	          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s3 0 1) x ((transferEff s3 0 1).pframe q)) True) ∧
268	    (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable 1) ∧
269	    ¬ NoLocalSelfLock s3 0 1 ∧ ¬ TransferPre K0 s3 0 1 := by decide
270	
271	end Examples
272	
273	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

8	/-!
9	# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant
10	
11	Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
12	§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`:
13	
14	* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
15	  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
16	* preservation of `KInv` (§57) by every step, `transfer` (§63) included, from states satisfying
17	  `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`; preservation of the auxiliaries `KAux` and
18	  `HeldAnchored` by every step; preservation of `I5` (§57) by every step from a `WF3` state;
19	* the initial state satisfies the invariant and the auxiliaries under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its
20	  `Init` leaves are the declared ones;
21	* the main invariant on reachable states (§57, `reachable_kinv`) and `I5` on reachable states
22	  (`reachable_i5`); the ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9
23	  (`reachable_cycle_rejected`);
24	* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
25	  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
26	  fails.
27	-/
28	
29	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
30	
31	/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/
32	
33	/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
34	inductive KernelOp where
35	  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
36	  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
37	  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
38	  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
39	  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
40	  | release (a : Nat)
41	  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
42	  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
43	  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
44	  | depend (q x : Nat)
45	  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
46	  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
47	  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
48	  | exit
49	  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
50	  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
51	  /-- O10 `write` (§67). -/
52	  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
53	  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68). -/
54	  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
55	  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
56	  | pin (p : Nat)
57	  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75), designating the dynamic pinning obligation of identity `o`. -/
58	  | unpin (o : Nat)
59	  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
60	  | endUse (p : Nat)
61	  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
62	  | free (p auth : Nat)
63	  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
64	  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
65	  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
66	  | store (a p : Nat)
67	
68	/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75): the step relation of the operation. -/
69	def KernelOp.Step (k : K) : KernelOp → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
70	  | .derive src region m => DeriveStep src region m
71	  | .split src rs => SplitStep k src rs
72	  | .release a => ReleaseStep a
73	  | .transfer src dst => TransferStep k src dst
74	  | .depend q x => DependStep q x
75	  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls
76	  | .exit => ExitStep k
77	  | .read a ls => Read3Step a ls
78	  | .write a ls => Write3Step a ls
79	  | .writeShared a ls => WriteSharedStep k a ls
80	  | .pin p => PinStep p
81	  | .unpin o => UnpinStep k o
82	  | .endUse p => EndUseStep k p
83	  | .free p auth => FreeStep k p auth
84	  | .alloc pr ow ls => AllocStep k pr ow ls
85	  | .store a p => StoreStep a p
86	
87	/-- A kernel step is the `ok` outcome of some operation O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
88	theorem kstep_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' ↔ ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') := by
89	  constructor
90	  · intro h
91	    cases h with
92	    | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
93	    | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
94	    | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
95	    | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
96	    | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
97	    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
98	    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
99	    | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
100	    | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _, h⟩
101	    | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _, h⟩
102	    | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
103	    | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
104	    | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
105	    | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
106	    | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
107	    | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
108	  · rintro ⟨op, h⟩
109	    cases op with
110	    | derive => exact .derive h
111	    | split => exact .split h
112	    | release => exact .release h
113	    | transfer => exact .transfer h
114	    | depend => exact .depend h
115	    | enter => exact .enter h
116	    | exit => exact .exit h
117	    | read => exact .read h
118	    | write => exact .write h
119	    | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
120	    | pin => exact .pin h
121	    | unpin => exact .unpin h
122	    | endUse => exact .endUse h
123	    | free => exact .free h
124	    | alloc => exact .alloc h
125	    | store => exact .store h
126	
127	/-- Finite runs of kernel steps from `s` (§57): the reflexive-transitive closure of `KStep`. -/
128	inductive KStar (k : K) (s : S3) : S3 → Prop where
129	  /-- The empty run (§57). -/
130	  | refl : KStar k s s
131	  /-- A run followed by one kernel step (§57). -/
132	  | tail {t u : S3} : KStar k s t → KStep k t u → KStar k s u
133	
134	/-- The reachable states of §57 are the states reached from `S3.init statics` by a finite run of
135	kernel steps. -/
136	theorem reachable_iff {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} :
137	    Reachable k statics s ↔ KStar k (S3.init statics) s := by
138	  constructor
139	  · intro h
140	    induction h with
141	    | init => exact .refl
142	    | step _ h ih => exact .tail ih h
143	  · intro h
144	    induction h with
145	    | refl => exact .init
146	    | tail _ h ih => exact .step ih h
147	
148	/-! ## Outcomes (§58) and the base frame (§39) -/
149	
150	/-- Only `alloc` may produce `fail` among O1–O16 (§58). -/
151	theorem op_fail_only_alloc {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s : S3} (h : op.Step k s .fail) :
152	    ∃ pr ow ls, op = .alloc pr ow ls := by
153	  cases op with
154	  | alloc pr ow ls => exact ⟨pr, ow, ls, rfl⟩
155	  | _ => exact (Alloc.guarded_ne_fail h).elim
156	
157	/-- No kernel step changes the bottom of the frame stack (§39: the base frame never exits). -/
158	theorem kstep_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
159	  cases h with
160	  | derive h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
161	  | split h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
162	  | release h =>
163	    rename_i a
164	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
165	    unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
166	  | transfer h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
167	  | depend h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
168	  | enter h => exact enter_keeps_base h
169	  | exit h => exact (exit_keeps_base h).2
170	  | read h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
171	  | write h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
172	  | writeShared h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
173	  | pin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
174	  | unpin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
175	  | endUse h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
176	  | free h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
177	  | alloc h => cases h with | ok => rfl
178	  | store h =>
179	    rename_i a p
180	    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
181	    unfold storeEff; split <;> rfl
182	
183	/-- On every reachable state, the bottom of the stack is the base frame 0 (§39, §47). -/
184	theorem reachable_base {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
185	    s.F.getLast? = some 0 := by
186	  induction h with
187	  | init => rfl
188	  | step _ h ih => rw [kstep_base h]; exact ih
189	
190	/-- The base frame 0 is never removed from the stack of a reachable state (§39). -/
191	theorem reachable_base_mem {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
192	    0 ∈ s.F :=
193	  List.mem_of_getLast? (reachable_base h)
194	
195	/-! ## Preservation by every step (§57, §58) -/
196	
197	/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv`
198	and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57, used by `transfer`, §63) to its `ok`
199	outcome, under `DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
200	theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
201	    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
202	  cases op with
203	  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv h
204	  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv h
205	  | release => exact release_preserves hinv h
206	  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves hinv hheld h
207	  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv h
208	  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv h
209	  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv h
210	  | read => exact read_preserves hinv h
211	  | write => exact write_preserves hinv h
212	  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv h
213	  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv h
214	  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv h
215	  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv h
216	  | free => exact free_preserves hinv h
217	  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv h
218	  | store => exact store_preserves hinv h
219	
220	/-- Every operation, `transfer` included, preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (`RootHeldConv`, §40,
221	§49.7; not a clause of §57) from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` to its `ok`
222	outcome. -/
223	theorem op_preserves_kAux {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
224	    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
225	  cases op with
226	  | derive => exact derive_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
227	  | split => exact split_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
228	  | release => exact release_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
229	  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_kAux haux h
230	  | depend => exact depend_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
231	  | enter => exact enter_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
232	  | exit => exact exit_preserves_kAux haux h
233	  | read => exact read_preserves_kAux haux h
234	  | write => exact write_preserves_kAux haux h

236	  | pin => exact pin_preserves_kAux haux h
237	  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_kAux haux h
238	  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_kAux haux h
239	  | free => exact free_preserves_kAux haux h
240	  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_kAux hinv haux h
241	  | store => exact store_preserves_rootHeldConv haux h
242	
243	/-- Every operation preserves `I5` (§57: every leaf pinned statically or by an active obligation
244	of §74 belongs to a usable place) from a `WF3` state (§49) to its `ok` outcome. `WF3` is used by
245	`transfer` (§63.9), `endUse` (§69) and `free` (§70). -/
246	theorem op_preserves_i5 {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s)
247	    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : I5 k s' := by
248	  cases op with
249	  | derive => exact derive_preserves_i5 h5 h
250	  | split => exact split_preserves_i5 h5 h
251	  | release => exact release_preserves_i5 h5 h
252	  | transfer => exact transfer_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
253	  | depend => exact depend_preserves_i5 h5 h
254	  | enter => exact enter_preserves_i5 h5 h
255	  | exit => exact exit_preserves_i5 h5 h
256	  | read => exact read_preserves_i5 h5 h
257	  | write => exact write_preserves_i5 h5 h
258	  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves_i5 h5 h
259	  | pin => exact pin_preserves_i5 h5 h
260	  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves_i5 h5 h
261	  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
262	  | free => exact free_preserves_i5 hw h5 h
263	  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves_i5 h5 h
264	  | store => exact store_preserves_i5 h5 h
265	
266	/-- Every kernel step preserves `KInv` (§57) from a state satisfying `KInv` and the auxiliary
267	`HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57), under `DDSound` (§80). -/
268	theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
269	    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : KStep k s s') : KInv s' := by
270	  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
271	  exact op_preserves hdd hinv hheld hop
272	
273	/-- Every kernel step preserves `I5` (§57, §74) from a `WF3` state (§49). -/
274	theorem kstep_preserves_i5 {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (h5 : I5 k s) (h : KStep k s s') :
275	    I5 k s' := by
276	  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
277	  exact op_preserves_i5 hw h5 hop

280	(§57) and `KAux`. -/
281	theorem kstep_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
282	    (h : KStep k s s') : KAux s' := by
283	  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
284	  exact op_preserves_kAux hinv haux hop

286	/-! ## `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every step (§44, §65, §63) -/

289	(§44), or it was already such an authority before the step and the step keeps the anchors of `q`
290	when `q` was usable (§52). Under `WF3` (§49.8) this gives `HeldAnchored` after the step. -/
291	private theorem heldAnchored_of_step {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
292	    (hstep : ∀ x y q, s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
293	      y.holder = .place q → x ∈ s'.D q ∨ ∃ y₀ : Authority, s.A[x]? = some y₀ ∧

/-- The auxiliary `HeldAnchored` (not a clause of §57) is preserved by every kernel step from a
`WF3` state (§44, §49). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh hop

/-! ## The initial state (§47) -/

/-- The places of `S3.init statics` are the declared statics (§47). -/
private theorem initP_len (statics : Statics) : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by
  simp [S3.init, shapeP]

/-- The place of a static (§47): its declared parent, its owner (the owning static or frame 0),
its kind. -/
private theorem initP_get {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < statics.length) :
    (S3.init statics).P[i]? = some ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1),
      shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i,
      (((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  simp only [S3.init, shapeP, List.nil_append, List.getElem?_map,
    List.getElem?_range (show i < (statics.map (·.1)).length by simpa using hi)]
  rfl

/-- A place of `S3.init statics` is a declared static (§47). -/
private theorem initP_get' {statics : Statics} {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
    (h : (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl) : q < statics.length ∧
      pl = ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).bind (·.1),
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) q,
        (((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  have hq : q < statics.length := by have := lt_of_getElem? h; rwa [initP_len] at this
  rw [initP_get hq] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hq, rfl⟩

/-- The authorities of `S3.init statics` are the root authorities of the root statics (§47). -/
private theorem initA_get {statics : Statics} {j : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (h : (S3.init statics).A[j]? = some z) : ∃ i, (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i ∧
      z = ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩ := by
  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

/-- A root static is a declared element with no parent (§40, §47). -/
private theorem rootIdx_get {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {j i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx ls)[j]? = some i) : i < ls.length ∧ (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
  have := List.mem_of_getElem? h
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at this
  exact this

/-- The parent of a static is an earlier static with the same owner (`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
private theorem statics_parent {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i r : Nat}
    (hi : i < statics.length) (hr : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1) = some r) :
    r < i ∧ ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.2.1) := by
  have h1 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).1
  rw [hr] at h1
  obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := h1
  exact ⟨by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- The owning static of a static is an earlier static (`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
private theorem statics_owner {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i o : Nat}
    (hi : i < statics.length) (ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = some o) : o < i := by
  have h2 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).2
  rw [ho] at h2
  have := h2.2
  omega

/-- Every static is usable in the initial state (§40, §47): its owners lead to frame 0. -/
private theorem init_usable {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i
  | 0, _, hn, _ => absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hn, hi => by
    have hpl := initP_get hi
    cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
    | none =>
      exact .frame (f := 0) hpl rfl (by unfold shapeOwner; rw [ho]) (List.mem_singleton_self _)
    | some o =>
      have := statics_owner h hi ho
      exact .place (o := o) hpl rfl (by unfold shapeOwner; rw [ho]) (init_usable h n o (by omega)
        (by omega))

/-- A place of `S3.init statics` is a declared static (§40, §47). -/
private theorem init_lt_of_mem_footprint {statics : Statics} {q l : Nat}
    (h : l ∈ footprint (S3.init statics).P q) : q < statics.length := by
  obtain ⟨hl, -, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  rw [initP_len] at hl
  rcases hlq with rfl | hc
  · exact hl
  · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hc) hl

/-- A root static is a root place of the initial state (§40, §47). -/
private theorem init_rootPlace {statics : Statics} {j i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i) : RootPlace (S3.init statics).P i := by
  obtain ⟨hil, hin⟩ := rootIdx_get h
  have hi : i < statics.length := by simpa using hil
  exact ⟨by rw [initP_len]; exact hi,
    by simp only [parentOf, initP_get hi, Option.bind_some]; exact hin⟩

/-- Root authorities of distinct positions are roots of distinct statics (§47: one root authority
per root static). -/
private theorem init_root_inj {statics : Statics} {j j' i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i)
    (h' : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j']? = some i) : j = j' :=
  Frames.getElem?_inj_of_lt ((Frames.range_pairwise_lt _).filter _) h h'

/-- The initial state satisfies `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and
`HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) for a well-formed statics declaration (`StaticsOK`, §47:
acyclic ownership of statics; §49, ordering of identifiers). -/
theorem init_kinv {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KInv (S3.init statics) ∧ KAux (S3.init statics) ∧ HeldAnchored (S3.init statics) := by
  have hus : ∀ i, i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i :=
    fun i hi => init_usable hst (i + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hi
  have hof : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .frame f → f < (S3.init statics).nF := by
    intro q pl f hq ho
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
    split at ho
    · cases ho
    · cases ho; exact Nat.zero_lt_one
  have hop : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl →
      pl.owner = .place o → o < (S3.init statics).P.length := by
    intro q pl o hq ho
    obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
    simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
    split at ho
    · rename_i o' ho'
      cases ho
      rw [initP_len]; exact Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hql ho') hql
    · cases ho
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := {
    frames := ⟨by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init]⟩
    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
      obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
      obtain ⟨hrq, hown⟩ := statics_parent hst hql hp
      exact ⟨_, initP_get (by omega), hrq, by simp only [shapeOwner, hown], rfl⟩
    owners := ⟨hof, hop, fun _ hq => hq.frameOf⟩
    footprints := fun a x ha l hl => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨(mem_footprint.1 hl).1, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.1⟩
    origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
    rootChain := fun a y l ha hl _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨a, _, i, .inl rfl, ha, rfl, init_rootPlace hi, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2,
        fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    rootHeld := fun r hr _ => by
      have hrl : r < statics.length := by have := hr.1; rwa [initP_len] at this
      have hpn : ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
        have := hr.2; simp only [parentOf, initP_get hrl, Option.bind_some] at this; exact this
      have hmem : r ∈ rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)) := by
        simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, List.length_map, hrl, hpn,
          Option.isNone_none, and_self]
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Frames.exists_getElem?_of_mem hmem
      refine ⟨j, ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P r,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) r, true⟩, _, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, initP_get hrl,
        rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
      simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl
    holders := fun a y ha _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      have hil : i < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
      show HolderLive _ (shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i)
      unfold shapeOwner
      cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
      | none => exact List.mem_singleton_self _
      | some o => exact hus o (Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hil ho) hil) }
  have hconv : RootHeldConv (S3.init statics) := fun x z l r hx _ hl hrp hlr => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get hx
    obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp (init_rootPlace hi) hlr (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2
    have hil : r < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
    exact ⟨_, initP_get hil, rfl⟩
  have hi1 : I1 (S3.init statics) := fun a b x y p hab ha hb _ _ xp yp _ _ => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
    obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := initA_get hb
    have hii : i ≠ i' := fun e => hab (init_root_inj hi (e ▸ hi'))
    exact absurd (rootOf_unique (init_rootPlace hi) (init_rootPlace hi') (mem_footprint.1 xp).2.2
      (mem_footprint.1 yp).2.2) hii
  have hnd : NoDangling (S3.init statics) := fun _ _ _ _ q hq l hl _ =>
    hq (hus q (init_lt_of_mem_footprint hl))
  have haoh : AnchorOrderHeld (S3.init statics) := fun q hq x y hy _ hhq => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy
    have hex : (S3.init statics).effAnchor x = x := by
      have : (S3.init statics).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy]
      simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
    have hf0 : f = 0 := List.mem_singleton.1 hfF
    subst hf0
    have hhq' : shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i = .place q := hhq
    unfold EffAnchorOK
    rw [hex, hy]
    simp only [OptP, hhq', S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
    exact hfF
  refine ⟨kInv_of hw ⟨⟨hi1, ?_, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, hnd⟩ haoh,
    hconv, fun x y q hy _ ho _ _ => ?_⟩
  · intro b y a hb ho
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
  · cases hx
  · cases hx
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy; exact absurd rfl ho

/-- The `Init` leaves of the initial state are exactly the statics declared `Init` (§47, §59). -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) hold on every
state reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound` (§80), for well-formed statics
(`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
theorem reachable_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    exact ⟨kstep_preserves hdd ih.1 ih.2.2 h, kstep_preserves_kAux ih.1 ih.2.1 h,
      kstep_preserves_heldAnchored ih.1.1 ih.2.2 h⟩

/-- The main invariant of §57: on states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`
(§80), `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan` holds, for well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`,
§47). -/
theorem reachable_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : KInv s :=
  (reachable_inv hdd hst h).1

/-- `I5` (§57) on reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every leaf
pinned statically (`K.Pinned`) or by an active obligation (§74) belongs to a usable place in every
reachable state. No hypothesis on `K.Pinned`: initially every static is usable (§47) and a leaf
lies in its own footprint (§40). -/
theorem reachable_i5 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : I5 k s := by
  induction h with
  | init =>
    intro l hlt hleaf _
    exact ⟨l, init_usable hst (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) (by rwa [initP_len] at hlt),
      mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlt, hleaf, hlt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  | step hr h ih => exact kstep_preserves_i5 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 ih h

open TransferWitness in
/-- The ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9: `cyc2` is reachable under a contract
with `DDSound` (§80), `transfer(0, 3)` from it is rejected because its destination would not be
usable, and the resulting state of that transfer, which violates `KInv` (§49.8, §54), is not
reachable (§57). -/
theorem reachable_cycle_rejected : Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 ∧
    TransferStep Examples.K0 0 3 cyc2 .reject ∧ ¬ Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc3 := by
  obtain ⟨hdd, hr, -, -, -, -, hrej, hn⟩ := transfer_cycle_rejected
  exact ⟨hr, hrej, fun h => hn (reachable_kinv hdd (by decide) h)⟩

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .writeShared _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .store _ p => l = p
  | .transfer src dst => l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
      ∃ l' ∈ footprint s.P src, corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants

/-!
# Access kernel: conforming statics declarations and their numbering

`StaticsConf` is the conformance of a statics declaration to §47 and §49 with no order between
identifiers. `StaticsOK` (`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants`) asks parents and owning statics to
be earlier statics; by §49 (last paragraph) this ordering only represents well-formedness. Every
conforming declaration has a consistent renumbering satisfying `StaticsOK`
(`StaticsConf.exists_renumber`), and every declaration satisfying `StaticsOK` conforms
(`StaticsConf.of_staticsOK`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Conformance (§40, §47, §49) -/

/-- Structural parent of static `i` (§40): `none` for a root static or an index outside the
declaration. -/
def staticParent (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (statics[i]?).bind (·.1.1)

/-- Owning static of static `i` (§40, §47): `none` for a static owned by frame 0 or an index
outside the declaration. -/
def staticOwner (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (statics[i]?).bind (·.1.2.1)

/-- Conformance of a statics declaration to §47 and §49, with no order between identifiers
(§49, last paragraph). Owners are frame 0 or a static (§40, §47), parents and owning statics are
declared statics (§49.2, §49.3), composition links are acyclic (§49.2), no static is owned,
directly or transitively, by itself (§47), and every structural part has its parent's owner
(§49.2, §40).

Acyclicity is the irreflexivity of the transitive closure `Relation.TransGen` of the one-step
link (`a`'s parent, resp. owning static, is `b`): `TransGen link i i` holds exactly when a
nonempty chain of links leads from `i` back to `i`, which is what §47 ("owned, directly or
transitively, by itself") and §49.2 (acyclic composition links) exclude. No bound on chain
length is involved. -/
structure StaticsConf (statics : Statics) : Prop where
  /-- §49.2: composition links are valid; every structural parent is a declared static. -/
  parent_lt : ∀ i p, staticParent statics i = some p → p < statics.length
  /-- §49.3, §47: owners are valid; every owning static is a declared static. -/
  owner_lt : ∀ i o, staticOwner statics i = some o → o < statics.length
  /-- §49.2: composition links are acyclic; no static is its own strict structural ancestor. -/
  parent_acyclic : ∀ i, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => staticParent statics a = some b) i i
  /-- §47: no static is owned, directly or transitively, by itself. -/
  owner_acyclic : ∀ i, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => staticOwner statics a = some b) i i
  /-- §49.2, §40: every structural part shares its parent's owner. -/
  part_owner : ∀ i p, staticParent statics i = some p →
    staticOwner statics i = staticOwner statics p

/-! ## Renumbering (§49, last paragraph; §63.2) -/

/-- A static's entry with its references, parent and owning static, mapped through `τ`; its
kind and initial state are kept (§49, last paragraph). -/
def mapRefs (τ : Nat → Nat) (e : (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool) :
    (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool :=
  ((e.1.1.map τ, e.1.2.1.map τ, e.1.2.2), e.2)

/-- Renumbering of a declaration by `σ` (§49, last paragraph): new index `i` holds old static
`σ[i]`, its parent and owning static mapped through the inverse `σ.idxOf`. Meant for `σ` a
permutation of `List.range statics.length`. -/
def renumber (σ : List Nat) (statics : Statics) : Statics :=
  σ.map fun j => mapRefs σ.idxOf ((statics[j]?).getD ((none, none, 0), false))

/-- Consistent renumbering (§49, last paragraph; §63.2): the new index `σ.idxOf x` of every old
static `x` holds `x` with its parent and owning static mapped through `σ.idxOf`, and its kind and
initial state; the parts of every place keep their relative order, which is their positional
field order (§63.2; `kids` orders the parts of a place by index). -/
structure ConsistentRenumbering (σ : List Nat) (statics : Statics) : Prop where
  /-- Parents to parents, owning statics to owning statics, same kind and initial state. -/
  entry : ∀ x < statics.length,
    (renumber σ statics)[σ.idxOf x]? = (statics[x]?).map (mapRefs σ.idxOf)
  /-- §63.2: the field order of every place is preserved. -/
  field_order : ∀ x y p, staticParent statics x = some p → staticParent statics y = some p →
    x < y → σ.idxOf x < σ.idxOf y

/-! ## Proof support: chains of a partial link -/

/-- Pigeonhole: a duplicate-free list of numbers below `n` has at most `n` elements. -/
private theorem nodup_length_le : ∀ (n : Nat) (l : List Nat), l.Nodup → (∀ a ∈ l, a < n) →
    l.length ≤ n
  | 0, [], _, _ => Nat.le_refl _
  | 0, a :: _, _, h => absurd (h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)) (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, l, hd, h => by
    have := nodup_length_le n (l.erase n) (hd.erase n) fun a ha => by
      rw [hd.mem_erase_iff] at ha
      have := h a ha.2
      omega
    rw [List.length_erase] at this
    split at this <;> omega

/-- `k` links `f` from `x`. -/
private def iter (f : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, x => some x
  | k + 1, x => (iter f k x).bind f

private theorem iter_add (f : Nat → Option Nat) (x i : Nat) : ∀ d,
    iter f (i + d) x = (iter f i x).bind (iter f d)
  | 0 => by
    show iter f i x = _
    cases iter f i x <;> rfl
  | d + 1 => by
    show (iter f (i + d) x).bind f = _
    rw [iter_add f x i d, Option.bind_assoc]
    rfl

private theorem transGen_of_iter {f : Nat → Option Nat} {x : Nat} : ∀ {k y : Nat},
    iter f (k + 1) x = some y → Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) x y
  | 0, _, h => .single h
  | k + 1, _, h => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hcy⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 h
    exact .tail (transGen_of_iter hc) hcy

/-- An acyclic partial link whose targets are below `n` has chains of fewer than `n` links from
any `x < n`. -/
private theorem iter_bound {f : Nat → Option Nat} {n : Nat}
    (hacyc : ∀ a, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) a a)
    (hlt : ∀ a b, f a = some b → b < n) {x : Nat} (hx : x < n) {k : Nat}
    (hk : (iter f k x).isSome) : k < n := by
  let g := fun i => (iter f i x).getD 0
  have hsome : ∀ i ≤ k, iter f i x = some (g i) := by
    intro i hi
    have := iter_add f x i (k - i)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' hi] at this
    cases hc : iter f i x with
    | none => rw [hc] at this; rw [this] at hk; simp at hk
    | some c => simp [g, hc]
  have hlt' : ∀ a ∈ (List.range (k + 1)).map g, a < n := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
    have hi' := hsome i (by rw [List.mem_range] at hi; omega)
    cases i with
    | zero => simp only [iter, Option.some.injEq] at hi'; omega
    | succ j =>
      obtain ⟨c, -, hc⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 hi'
      exact hlt c _ hc
  have hnd : ((List.range (k + 1)).map g).Nodup := by
    unfold List.Nodup
    rw [List.pairwise_map]
    refine List.pairwise_lt_range.imp_of_mem fun {i j} hi hj hij heq => ?_
    rw [List.mem_range] at hi hj
    have hj' := iter_add f x i (j - i)
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.le_of_lt hij), hsome i (by omega), hsome j (by omega), heq,
      Option.bind_some] at hj'
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, j - i = d + 1 := ⟨j - i - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hd] at hj'
    exact hacyc _ (transGen_of_iter hj'.symm)
  have := nodup_length_le n _ hnd hlt'
  simp only [List.length_map, List.length_range] at this
  omega

/-- Length of the chain of links `f` from `x`, cut at `k` links. -/
private def chainLen (f : Nat → Option Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | k + 1, x => match f x with
    | none => 0
    | some y => chainLen f k y + 1

private theorem chainLen_some {f : Nat → Option Nat} {k x y : Nat} (h : f x = some y) :
    chainLen f (k + 1) x = chainLen f k y + 1 := by
  show (match f x with | none => 0 | some y => chainLen f k y + 1) = _
  rw [h]

private theorem chainLen_congr {f : Nat → Option Nat} {x y : Nat} (h : f x = f y) :
    ∀ k, chainLen f k x = chainLen f k y
  | 0 => rfl
  | _ + 1 => by simp only [chainLen, h]

private theorem iter_of_chainLen_ne {f : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ {k z : Nat},
    chainLen f (k + 1) z ≠ chainLen f k z → (iter f (k + 1) z).isSome
  | 0, z, h => by
    cases hz : f z with
    | none => simp [chainLen, hz] at h
    | some y => simp [iter, hz]
  | k + 1, z, h => by
    cases hz : f z with
    | none => simp [chainLen, hz] at h
    | some y =>
      rw [chainLen_some hz, chainLen_some hz] at h
      have := iter_add f z 1 (k + 1)
      rw [Nat.add_comm 1] at this
      rw [this]
      simp only [iter, Option.bind_some, hz]
      exact iter_of_chainLen_ne (by omega)

/-- Under an acyclic link with targets below `n`, the chain length cut at `n` grows by one along
each link. -/
private theorem chainLen_step {f : Nat → Option Nat} {n : Nat}
    (hacyc : ∀ a, ¬ Relation.TransGen (fun a b => f a = some b) a a)
    (hlt : ∀ a b, f a = some b → b < n) {x y : Nat} (h : f x = some y) :
    chainLen f n x = chainLen f n y + 1 := by
  have hy := hlt x y h
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [chainLen_some h]
  refine congrArg (· + 1) (Classical.byContradiction fun hne => ?_)
  have := iter_bound hacyc hlt hy (iter_of_chainLen_ne (k := m) (fun e => hne e.symm))
  omega

/-! ## Proof support: the order of a conforming declaration -/

/-- Ownership depth of a static. -/
private def odepth (statics : Statics) (x : Nat) : Nat :=
  chainLen (staticOwner statics) statics.length x

/-- Structural depth of a static. -/
private def sdepth (statics : Statics) (x : Nat) : Nat :=
  chainLen (staticParent statics) statics.length x

/-- Lexicographic order on (ownership depth, structural depth, index). -/
private def keyLe (statics : Statics) (a b : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (odepth statics a < odepth statics b ∨ odepth statics a = odepth statics b ∧
    (sdepth statics a < sdepth statics b ∨ sdepth statics a = sdepth statics b ∧ a ≤ b))

private theorem idxOf_lt_of_key {statics : Statics} {σ : List Nat}
    (hσ : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length)) (hs : σ.Pairwise (fun a b => keyLe statics a b))
    {x y : Nat} (hx : x < statics.length) (hy : y < statics.length)
    (hk : odepth statics x < odepth statics y ∨ odepth statics x = odepth statics y ∧
      (sdepth statics x < sdepth statics y ∨ sdepth statics x = sdepth statics y ∧ x < y)) :
    σ.idxOf x < σ.idxOf y := by
  have hix := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx))
  have hiy := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hy))
  have gx := List.getElem_idxOf hix
  have gy := List.getElem_idxOf hiy
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (σ.idxOf x) (σ.idxOf y) with h | h | h
  · exact h
  · have : x = y := by
      rw [← gx, ← gy]
      exact getElem_congr rfl h hix
    subst this
    omega
  · have := List.pairwise_iff_getElem.1 hs _ _ hiy hix h
    rw [gx, gy] at this
    simp only [keyLe, decide_eq_true_eq] at this
    omega

private theorem lt_of_parent {statics : Statics} {x p : Nat}
    (h : staticParent statics x = some p) : x < statics.length := by
  unfold staticParent at h
  cases hx : statics[x]? with
  | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
  | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1

private theorem lt_of_owner {statics : Statics} {x o : Nat}
    (h : staticOwner statics x = some o) : x < statics.length := by
  unfold staticOwner at h
  cases hx : statics[x]? with
  | none => rw [hx] at h; cases h
  | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hx).1

private theorem shape_parent (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) :
    ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1) = staticParent statics i := by
  simp only [List.getElem?_map, staticParent]
  cases statics[i]? <;> rfl

private theorem shape_owner (statics : Statics) (i : Nat) :
    ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = staticOwner statics i := by
  simp only [List.getElem?_map, staticOwner]
  cases statics[i]? <;> rfl

private theorem renumber_get {σ : List Nat} {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < σ.length)
    (hx : σ[i] < statics.length) :
    (renumber σ statics)[i]? = some (mapRefs σ.idxOf statics[σ[i]]) := by
  simp [renumber, hi, hx]

private theorem renumber_parent {σ : List Nat} {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < σ.length)
    (hx : σ[i] < statics.length) :
    staticParent (renumber σ statics) i = (staticParent statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf := by
  rw [staticParent, renumber_get hi hx, staticParent, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
  rfl

private theorem renumber_owner {σ : List Nat} {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < σ.length)
    (hx : σ[i] < statics.length) :
    staticOwner (renumber σ statics) i = (staticOwner statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf := by
  rw [staticOwner, renumber_get hi hx, staticOwner, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
  rfl

/-! ## Existence of a conforming numbering -/

/-- Owner decision of 2026-11-06 on `StaticsOK`, point (a) (§47, §49 and its last paragraph,
§63.2): every declaration conforming to §47 and §49 has a consistent renumbering, a permutation
of its identifiers preserving parents, owning statics, kinds, initial states and field order,
that satisfies `StaticsOK`. -/
theorem StaticsConf.exists_renumber {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsConf statics) :
    ∃ σ : List Nat, σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) ∧ ConsistentRenumbering σ statics ∧
      StaticsOK (renumber σ statics) := by
  let σ := (List.range statics.length).mergeSort (keyLe statics)
  have hσ : σ.Perm (List.range statics.length) := List.mergeSort_perm _ _
  have hs : σ.Pairwise (fun a b => keyLe statics a b) :=
    List.pairwise_mergeSort
      (fun a b c hab hbc => by simp only [keyLe, decide_eq_true_eq] at *; omega)
      (fun a b => by simp only [keyLe, Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) _
  have hnd : σ.Nodup := hσ.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
  have hown : ∀ x o, staticOwner statics x = some o → odepth statics x = odepth statics o + 1 :=
    fun _ _ hxo => chainLen_step h.owner_acyclic h.owner_lt hxo
  have hpar : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → sdepth statics x = sdepth statics p + 1 :=
    fun _ _ hxp => chainLen_step h.parent_acyclic h.parent_lt hxp
  have hpo : ∀ x p, staticParent statics x = some p → odepth statics x = odepth statics p :=
    fun x p hxp => chainLen_congr (h.part_owner x p hxp) _
  refine ⟨σ, hσ, ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun x y p hx hy hxy => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have hix := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx))
    simp [renumber, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hix, List.getElem_idxOf hix,
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem hx]
  · have := hpar x p hx
    have := hpar y p hy
    have := hpo x p hx
    have := hpo y p hy
    exact idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs (lt_of_parent hx) (lt_of_parent hy) (by omega)
  · unfold StaticsOK ShapeOK
    intro i hi
    simp only [List.length_map, renumber, List.mem_range] at hi
    have hxi : σ[i] < statics.length := List.mem_range.1 (hσ.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
    have hii : σ.idxOf σ[i] = i :=
      (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1 (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem
        (List.getElem_mem hi)))
    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add, renumber_parent hi hxi,
      renumber_owner hi hxi]
    constructor
    · cases hp : staticParent statics σ[i] with
      | none => trivial
      | some p =>
        have hpl := h.parent_lt _ _ hp
        have hip := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (hσ.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hpl))
        have hpσ : σ[σ.idxOf p] = p := List.getElem_idxOf hip
        refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, ?_, ?_⟩
        · have := hpar _ _ hp
          have := hpo _ _ hp
          have := idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs hpl hxi (by omega)
          show σ.idxOf p < i
          omega
        · show (staticOwner statics σ[i]).map σ.idxOf = staticOwner (renumber σ statics) (σ.idxOf p)
          rw [renumber_owner hip (by rw [hpσ]; exact hpl), hpσ, h.part_owner _ _ hp]
    · cases ho : staticOwner statics σ[i] with
      | none => trivial
      | some o =>
        have hol := h.owner_lt _ _ ho
        have := hown _ _ ho
        have := idxOf_lt_of_key hσ hs hol hxi (by omega)
        exact ⟨Nat.zero_le _, show σ.idxOf o < i by omega⟩

/-! ## `StaticsOK` declarations conform -/

private theorem rank_of_transGen {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} (rank : Nat → Nat)
    (h : ∀ a b, R a b → rank b < rank a) {a b : Nat} (hab : Relation.TransGen R a b) :
    rank b < rank a := by
  induction hab with
  | single hr => exact h _ _ hr
  | tail _ hr ih => exact Nat.lt_trans (h _ _ hr) ih

/-- `StaticsOK` (§47, §49) is a numbering of a conforming declaration: it implies
`StaticsConf`. -/
theorem StaticsConf.of_staticsOK {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
    StaticsConf statics := by
  have hok : ∀ i, i < statics.length →
      OptP (staticParent statics i)
        (fun r => r < i ∧ staticOwner statics i = staticOwner statics r) True ∧
      OptP (staticOwner statics i) (fun o => o < i) True := by
    intro i hi
    have := h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))
    simp only [shape_parent, shape_owner, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.zero_add] at this
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := this
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · cases hp : staticParent statics i with
      | none => trivial
      | some r =>
        rw [hp] at h1
        obtain ⟨-, h3, h4⟩ := h1
        exact ⟨h3, h4⟩
    · cases ho : staticOwner statics i with
      | none => trivial
      | some o =>
        rw [ho] at h2
        exact h2.2
  have hpar : ∀ a b, staticParent statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
    have := (hok a (lt_of_parent hab)).1
    rw [hab] at this
    exact this.1
  have hown : ∀ a b, staticOwner statics a = some b → b < a := fun a b hab => by
    have := (hok a (lt_of_owner hab)).2
    rw [hab] at this
    exact this
  exact {
    parent_lt := fun i p hp => Nat.lt_trans (hpar i p hp) (lt_of_parent hp)
    owner_lt := fun i o ho => Nat.lt_trans (hown i o ho) (lt_of_owner ho)
    parent_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hpar hc)
    owner_acyclic := fun _ hc => Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen id hown hc)
    part_owner := fun i p hp => by
      have := (hok i (lt_of_parent hp)).1
      rw [hp] at this
      exact this.2 }

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §49, §63.2) -/

namespace StaticsExamples

/-- Static 0 is a part of static 1, declared before it (§49, last paragraph). -/
def partFirst : Statics := [((some 1, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 1), false)]

/-- `partFirst` is not numbered parent first. -/
example : ¬ StaticsOK partFirst := by decide

private theorem partFirst_owner : ∀ i, staticOwner partFirst i = none
  | 0 | 1 | _ + 2 => rfl

/-- `partFirst` conforms to §47 and §49. -/
example : StaticsConf partFirst where
  parent_lt i p hp := by
    rcases i with _ | _ | i <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hp ⊢
    omega
  owner_lt i o ho := by rw [partFirst_owner] at ho; cases ho
  parent_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun a => if a = 1 then 0 else 1)
    (fun a b hab => by
      rcases a with _ | _ | a <;> simp [staticParent, partFirst] at hab
      subst hab; decide) hc)
  owner_acyclic _ hc := Nat.lt_irrefl _ (rank_of_transGen (fun _ => 0)
    (fun a b hab => by rw [partFirst_owner] at hab; cases hab) hc)
  part_owner i p _ := by rw [partFirst_owner, partFirst_owner]

/-- Its renumbering by `[1, 0]` satisfies `StaticsOK`. -/
example : StaticsOK (renumber [1, 0] partFirst) := by decide

/-- Two fields 0 and 1 of static 2, declared before it (§63.2). -/
def fieldsFirst : Statics :=
  [((some 2, none, 0), true), ((some 2, none, 1), false), ((none, none, 2), false)]

/-- Swapping the fields gives a declaration satisfying `StaticsOK`, but not a consistent
renumbering: the field order clause is not vacuous (§63.2). -/
example : StaticsOK (renumber [2, 1, 0] fieldsFirst) ∧
    ¬ ConsistentRenumbering [2, 1, 0] fieldsFirst :=
  ⟨by decide, fun h => absurd (h.field_order 0 1 2 rfl rfl (by decide)) (by decide)⟩

/-- An ownership cycle does not conform (§47). -/
example : ¬ StaticsConf [((none, some 1, 0), true), ((none, some 0, 0), true)] :=
  fun h => h.owner_acyclic 0 (.tail (.single rfl) rfl)

end StaticsExamples

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-!
# Access kernel: shared lemmas

Lemmas shared by the preservation proofs of the kernel operations of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75: origin and parent chains (§40, §42),
footprints and frames of places (§40), effective modes (§43), the grounding of a right (§43,
§63.4, §69.2, §70.3), exclusivity under `I1` (§50), active origins under `I2` (§51), additions of
authorities (§42, §60, §61), states with the same authorities up to holders (§63), consequences
of `WF3` (§49), usability (§40), root places (§40, §49.6, §49.7), the shape of `transfer` (§63),
`NoOrphan` from `WF3` (§54), and dynamic pinning obligations (§74, §75).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Chains (§40, §42, §49) -/

/-- A chain from an element without link is empty (§40 parents, §42 origins). -/
theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []
  | 0 => rfl
  | _ + 1 => by simp [chainF, h]

/-- Any fuel at least the start index gives the same chain (§40, §42; acyclicity, §49). -/
theorem chainF_fuel (org : Nat → Option Nat) :
    ∀ k₁ k₂ i, i ≤ k₁ → i ≤ k₂ → chainF org k₁ i = chainF org k₂ i
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | _ + 1, 0, i, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | k₁ + 1, k₂ + 1, i, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [chainF]; split
    · split
      · rw [chainF_fuel org k₁ k₂ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
      · rfl
    · rfl

/-!
# Access kernel: the preserved invariant

The conjunction that every kernel step must preserve (§57 of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`) and the auxiliary invariant carried with it. The per-operation preservation modules state their results with these two predicates.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The kernel invariant of §57: `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`. -/
def KInv (s : S3) : Prop := WF3 s ∧ Inv3 s ∧ AnchorOrderHeld s ∧ NoOrphan s

/-- Auxiliary invariant carried with `KInv`, not a clause of §57 (§40, §49.7): the converse
root-holder property `RootHeldConv`, which is not a clause of `WF3`. -/
def KAux (s : S3) : Prop := RootHeldConv s

/-- `NoOrphan` follows from `WF3` (§54, §49.7), so `KInv` reduces to its first three
conjuncts. -/
theorem kInv_of {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3 s) (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : KInv s :=
  ⟨hw, hi, ha, noOrphan_of_wf3 hw⟩

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
